text_en: Again he began to teach beside the sea. Such a very large crowd gathered around him that he got into a boat on the sea and sat there, while the whole crowd was beside the sea on the land.
text_cn: 耶稣又在海边上开始施教，有大伙群众聚集在他跟前，他只得上了一只船，在海上坐着，所有的群众都在海边地上。

text_en: He began to teach them many things in parables, and in his teaching he said to them:
text_cn: 他用比喻教训他们许多事，在施教时，他向他们说：

text_en: “Listen! A sower went out to sow.
text_cn: “你们听：有个撒种的出去撒种。

text_en: And as he sowed, some seed fell on the path, and the birds came and ate it up.
text_cn: 他撒种的时候，有的落在路旁，飞鸟来把它吃了；

text_en: Other seed fell on rocky ground, where it did not have much soil, and it sprang up quickly, since it had no depth of soil.
text_cn: 有的落在石头地里，那里没有多少土壤，即刻发了芽，因为所有的土壤不深，

text_en: And when the sun rose, it was scorched; and since it had no root, it withered away.
text_cn: 太阳一出来，被晒焦了；又因为没有根，就干枯了；

text_en: Other seed fell among thorns, and the thorns grew up and choked it, and it yielded no grain.
text_cn: 有的落在荆棘中，荆棘长起来，把它窒息了，就没有结实；

text_en: Other seed fell into good soil and brought forth grain, growing up and increasing and yielding thirty and sixty and a hundredfold. ”
text_cn: 有的落在好地里，就长大成熟，结了果实，有的结三十倍，有的六十倍，有的一百倍。”

text_en: And he said, “Let anyone with ears to hear listen! ”
text_cn: 他又说：“有耳听的，听罢！”

text_en: When he was alone, those who were around him along with the twelve asked him about the parables.
text_cn: 当耶稣独自一人的时候，那些跟从他的人和十二门徒便问他这些比喻的意义。

text_en: And he said to them, “To you has been given the secret of the kingdom of God, but for those outside, everything comes in parables;
text_cn: 耶稣对他们说：“天主国的奥义只赏给了你们，但对那些外人，一切都用比喻，

text_en: in order that ‘they may indeed look, but not perceive, and may indeed listen, but not understand; so that they may not turn again and be forgiven. ’”
text_cn: 使他们看是看，却看不见；听是听，却听不明白，免得他们回头，而得赦免。”

text_en: And he said to them, “Do you not understand this parable? Then how will you understand all the parables?
text_cn: 耶稣对他们说：“你们不明白这个比喻，又怎能明白其他的一切比喻呢？

text_en: The sower sows the word.
text_cn: 那撒种的人撒的，是所讲的‘话’。

text_en: These are the ones on the path where the word is sown: when they hear, Satan immediately comes and takes away the word that is sown in them.
text_cn: 那撒在路旁的‘话’，是指人听了后，撒殚立时来，把撒在他们心里的‘话’夺了去。

text_en: And these are the ones sown on rocky ground: when they hear the word, they immediately receive it with joy.
text_cn: 同样，那撒在石头地里的，是指人听了这‘话’后，立刻欣然接受；

text_en: But they have no root, and endure only for a while; then, when trouble or persecution arises on account of the word, immediately they fall away.
text_cn: 但他们心里没有根，不能持久，及至为了这‘话’发生艰难或迫害，立刻就跌倒了。

text_en: And others are those sown among the thorns: these are the ones who hear the word,
text_cn: 还有那撒在荆棘中的，是指人听了这‘话’后，

text_en: but the cares of the world, and the lure of wealth, and the desire for other things come in and choke the word, and it yields nothing.
text_cn: 世俗的焦虑，财富的迷惑，以及其他的贪欲进来，把‘话’蒙住了，结不出果实。

text_en: And these are the ones sown on the good soil: they hear the word and accept it and bear fruit, thirty and sixty and a hundredfold. ”
text_cn: 那撒在好地里的，是指人听了这‘话’，就接受了，并结了果实，有的三十倍，有的六十倍，有的一百倍。”

text_en: He said to them, “Is a lamp brought in to be put under the bushel basket, or under the bed, and not on the lampstand?
text_cn: 耶稣又向他们说：“人拿灯来，岂是为放在斗底或床下吗？不是为放在灯台上吗？

text_en: For there is nothing hidden, except to be disclosed; nor is anything secret, except to come to light.
text_cn: 因为没有什么隐藏的事，不是为显露出来的；也没有隐密的事，不是为彰明出来的。

text_en: Let anyone with ears to hear listen! ”
text_cn: 谁若有耳听，听罢！”

text_en: And he said to them, “Pay attention to what you hear; the measure you give will be the measure you get, and still more will be given you.
text_cn: 耶稣又向他们说：“要留心你们所听的：你们用什么尺度量给人，也要用什么尺度量给你们，且要多加给你们，

text_en: For to those who have, more will be given; and from those who have nothing, even what they have will be taken away. ”
text_cn: 因为凡有的，还要给他；凡没有的，连他所有的，也要从他夺去。”

text_en: He also said, “The kingdom of God is as if someone would scatter seed on the ground,
text_cn: 他又说：“天主的国好比一个人把种子撒在地里，

text_en: and would sleep and rise night and day, and the seed would sprout and grow, he does not know how.
text_cn: 他黑夜白天，或睡或起，那种子发芽生长，至于怎样，他却不知道，

text_en: The earth produces of itself, first the stalk, then the head, then the full grain in the head.
text_cn: 因为土地自然生长果实：先发苗，后吐穗，最后穗上满了麦粒。

text_en: But when the grain is ripe, at once he goes in with his sickle, because the harvest has come. ”
text_cn: 当果实成熟的时候，便立刻派人以镰刀收割，因为到了收获的时期。”

text_en: He also said, “With what can we compare the kingdom of God, or what parable will we use for it?
text_cn: 他又说：“我们以什么比拟天主的国呢？或用什么比喻来形容它呢？

text_en: It is like a mustard seed, which, when sown upon the ground, is the smallest of all the seeds on earth;
text_cn: 它好像一粒芥子，种在地里的时候，比地上一切的种子都小；

text_en: yet when it is sown it grows up and becomes the greatest of all shrubs, and puts forth large branches, so that the birds of the air can make nests in its shade. ”
text_cn: 当下种之后，生长起来，比一切蔬菜都大；并且长出大枝，以致天上的飞鸟能栖息在它的荫下。”

text_en: With many such parables he spoke the word to them, as they were able to hear it;
text_cn: 耶稣用许多这样的比喻，按照他们所能听懂的，给他们讲道。

text_en: he did not speak to them except in parables, but he explained everything in private to his disciples.
text_cn: 若不用比喻，他就不给他们讲什么，但私下里却给自己的门徒解释一切。

text_en: On that day, when evening had come, he said to them, “Let us go across to the other side. ”
text_cn: 在当天晚上，耶稣对门徒说：“我们渡海到对岸去罢！”

text_en: And leaving the crowd behind, they took him with them in the boat, just as he was. Other boats were with him.
text_cn: 他们遂离开群众，就照他在船上的原状，带他走了；与他一起的还有别的小船。

text_en: A great windstorm arose, and the waves beat into the boat, so that the boat was already being swamped.
text_cn: 忽然，狂风大作，波浪打进船内，以致小船已满了水。

text_en: But he was in the stern, asleep on the cushion; and they woke him up and said to him, “Teacher, do you not care that we are perishing? ”
text_cn: 耶稣却在船尾依枕而睡。他们叫醒他，给他说：“师傅！我们要丧亡了，你不管吗？”

text_en: He woke up and rebuked the wind, and said to the sea, “Peace! Be still! ” Then the wind ceased, and there was a dead calm.
text_cn: 耶稣醒来，叱责了风，并向海说：“不要作声，平定了罢！”风就停止了，遂大为平静。

text_en: He said to them, “Why are you afraid? Have you still no faith? ”
text_cn: 耶稣对他们说：“为什么你们这样胆怯？你们怎么还没有信德呢？”

text_en: And they were filled with great awe and said to one another, “Who then is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him? ”
text_cn: 他们非常惊惧，彼此说：“这人到底是谁？连风和海也听从他！”
